company_profile.summary: Hindalco Industries Ltd is the metals flagship of the Aditya Birla Group and the world's largest aluminum company by revenue. Hindalco operates a fully integrated aluminum value chain in India and is the global leader in flat-rolled aluminum products and aluminum beverage can recycling through its US-based wholly-owned subsidiary, Novelis Inc.

revenue_breakup.desc: Automotive body sheets, beverage can packaging, aerospace aluminum, and specialty plates.
Bauxite mining, alumina refining, primary smelting, extruded sections, and aluminum foils.
Custom copper smelting, continuous cast copper rods, and precious metal recovery at Dahej.

company_profile.geographic_mix: North America & Europe (Novelis): 65% • India: 28% • South America & Asia: 7%
moats_and_strengths: Novelis is the undisputed global leader in beverage can sheet production with multi-year supply contracts with global beverage giants.
World's largest recycler of aluminum, melting over 82 billion used beverage cans annually with 95% less energy than primary metal.
Indian primary aluminum operations sit in the first quartile of the global cost curve due to captive bauxite and coal mines.
Dahej copper complex is one of the largest single-location custom copper smelters in the world.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Novelis Shipments: ~3.8M tonnes/year • India Aluminum: 1.3 MTPA smelting • Copper Cathode: 500,000 tonnes

bullish_triggers: Commissioning of Novelis' $4.1B greenfield rolling and recycling plant in Bay Minette, Alabama.
Secular shift from plastic and glass to infinitely recyclable aluminum beverage cans globally.
Surging lightweighting demand for automotive aluminum in electric vehicles (EVs).
bearish_risks: Capital cost inflation and commissioning execution delays at the Bay Minette expansion.
LME aluminum spot price swings impacting primary smelting margins in the Indian business.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
